title: Heɗtiiɓe Suuɗiiɓe Goongɗinɓe
intro: E nder deeƴre mooɓondiral ceniingal, mooɓondiral kaawningal arii ummoraade e leydi ndi yi’aaka. Naatde e ɓuuɓri huunde haawniinde, ɓe keɗii jaŋngugol ngol siimtata baasal maɓɓe haa abada. Seedeeji maɓɓe ina keddii e ɓurɗi teeŋtude e binndol Alla.
clues: Minen ko min tagooje ummoriiɗe e leydi ndi ko ɓuri heewde e yimɓe njiyataa, min ngari ko e fedde.
Min njahi haa min njottii mooɓondiral ngam nande huunde haawniinde.
Nde min njottii, min keɗii jaŋngugol ngol min kaawnii.
En njaɓii e peeñcu wonde won e men ko peewɓe won heen ko peewaani.
En nganndii en mbaawaa daɗde e yamiroore Alla e dow leydi, walla e dogde e asamaan.
Nde min nani ardaade, min ngoongɗini ɗum; kala gooŋɗinɗo joom mum hulataa majjude walla teddeendi.

outcome.label: Keeɓal

outcome.answer: Min ngoongɗini, min njeertini leñol amen

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
